seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of red marbles; one cell at row 3 col 4 holds a slightly more orange marble. Lighting uniform.
seeds.question: Which cell contains the odd-one-out, and how does it differ?
seeds.lever: Detect a low-magnitude hue outlier in a uniform grid.

seeds.scene: A 5×5 dot grid; all dots 1 cm except one dot at row 4 col 1 measuring 1.2 cm.
seeds.question: Which dot is the odd-one-out?
seeds.lever: Detect a small size outlier among uniform-size repeats.

seeds.scene: A 6×6 grid of arrows all pointing east, except one arrow at row 2 col 5 pointing east-northeast (~15° rotated).
seeds.question: Which arrow is rotated differently?
seeds.lever: Detect small angular deviation in uniform-orientation array.

seeds.scene: A grid of 25 circles; one cell contains a slightly elliptical shape (aspect ratio 1.1) instead of a true circle.
seeds.question: Which cell has the odd shape?
seeds.lever: Detect mild ellipticity outlier.

seeds.scene: A row of 12 dominoes evenly spaced 1 cm apart, except one gap between dominoes 7 and 8 is 1.4 cm.
seeds.question: Between which two dominoes is the odd gap?
seeds.lever: Detect spacing irregularity by careful measurement comparison.

seeds.scene: A menu page with 12 dish names in serif font; one dish name is set in sans-serif.

seeds.lever: Detect font-family outlier vs uniform layout.

seeds.scene: A grid of 24 cans of the same product brand; 23 cans show red logos, 1 can shows a slightly orange-red logo (different print run).
seeds.question: Which can has the off-color logo?
seeds.lever: Detect subtle logo color outlier in product wall.

seeds.scene: A polka-dot fabric tile with each polka cluster containing 5 dots, except one cluster containing 4.
seeds.question: Which cluster has fewer dots?
seeds.lever: Detect count outlier in repeated micro-pattern.

seeds.scene: A row of 8 cubicles all lit with white LED, except one with warm yellow tungsten bulb.
seeds.question: Which cubicle has the odd lighting?
seeds.lever: Detect color-temperature outlier in lighting.

seeds.scene: A bookshelf row of 30 books all standing perfectly vertical, except one tilted ~10°.

seeds.scene: A repeating geometric tile floor pattern; one tile has a small chip missing, breaking the pattern.

seeds.lever: Detect pattern break vs intact tiles.

seeds.scene: A paragraph of body text in 12pt; one letter (in a normal word) appears in bold by mistake.
seeds.question: Which letter is in bold?
seeds.lever: Detect single-character formatting outlier.

seeds.scene: A paint-chip wall with 30 chips of green; one chip is shifted very slightly toward yellow-green.
seeds.question: Which chip is the odd hue?
seeds.lever: Detect minimal hue shift in dense color array.

seeds.scene: A row of 6 egg cartons each containing 12 eggs except one carton with 11.
seeds.question: Which carton has fewer eggs?
seeds.lever: Detect count outlier across containers.

seeds.scene: A parking lot with 20 white sedans and 1 cream-colored sedan, all otherwise identical.
seeds.question: Which car is the off-color one?
seeds.lever: Detect minor color outlier across uniform array.

seeds.scene: A long form list with 15 entries handwritten in blue pen; one entry written in black pen.
seeds.question: Which entry is in the wrong ink color?
seeds.lever: Detect ink color outlier in long handwritten list.

seeds.scene: A clock dial with 12 hour-marks all rectangular, except one (the 9-position mark) which is round.
seeds.question: Which hour mark has the wrong shape?
seeds.lever: Detect shape outlier in hour-mark periodic pattern.

seeds.scene: A row of 14 cups on a shelf with handles all facing left, except one with handle facing right.
seeds.question: Which cup is the orientation outlier?
seeds.lever: Detect orientation outlier across uniform array.

seeds.scene: A row of 7 nested-doll dolls, each ~10% smaller than the previous, except one position breaks the gradient (too-small jump).
seeds.question: Which position breaks the size pattern?
seeds.answer: the doll position with anomalous jump
seeds.lever: Detect deviation from monotone size progression.

seeds.scene: A stack of 24 identical-looking boxes labeled 'BOX 001'…'BOX 024'; one box mistakenly labeled 'BOX 16' instead of 'BOX 016' (missing leading zero).
seeds.question: Which box has a labeling format anomaly?
